description:
FILED s527d (2026-10-31), PPI catalogue §44, task #3751.  s527d's group AA (branch pcl, cf13afb5) makes CORE::__END__ / CORE::__DATA__ a Token::Separator that ends the code.  PPI's Lexer.pm picks the statement class by the Separator's CONTENT (`'__DATA__' => 'PPI::Statement::Data', '__END__' => 'PPI::Statement::End'`, Lexer.pm ~378), so the CORE:: spellings land in a plain PPI::Statement, and PCL drops that statement LOUDLY (the drop is a run-time die at that point).  Repro: `print "x
";
CORE::__END__
not code
` -- perl prints x; PCL (s527d tree) prints x then dies at the dropped statement (main died 'Undefined subroutine &main::__END__').  Fix on the branch (Lexer.pm is s527e's file): key the table on the content with a leading CORE:: removed; a report row in t/ppi_bugs_pcl.t asserting the Statement::End / Statement::Data class; then PCL's emission for t/op/coreamp.t:1225 checked.

=== DONE (s527f) ===
PPI branch pcl-s527f: ac62cb85 (TODO tests, 2 rows) + 49a24b96 (Lexer: %STATEMENT_CLASSES knows CORE::__END__ / CORE::__DATA__ -> Statement::End / ::Data), the second fix commit of group AA.  PCL: Pl::Parser::_core_separator_statements made INERT (died where it would act; never fired) then DELETED with both call sites (fe11b3dd); corpus-diff IDENTICAL vs 2857cd7f after each.  Twin report rows +2. Generation v2-9700 (renumbered above s527g's v2-9600); pushed: pcl c4d0da86 -> 9286f7c0.
subject: HAND-OVER to s527e (Lexer.pm): CORE::__END__ / CORE::__DATA__ need the Lexer's statement-class table entries (Statement::End / Statement::Data)
